correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md constructs H from mod-2 dot products, proves its unimodular Boolean-zeta factorization Z diag((-2)^(|T|-1)) Z^T, identifies C^T image as the matrix sums u_b+v_a, and computes the constant-vector intersection via H(2H-J)=2^(m-1)I. The exact image-size formula for every modulus D and rational rank determine all Smith factors; character orthogonality gives the full flat reduced density spectrum, including composite D. Hypotheses m>=2, D>=2, two transverse binary isotropic subspaces, unit edge weights all used. An independently coded SymPy Smith-form calculation for m=2,3 and D=2,3,4,6 reproduces the formula. Those finite checks do not establish the arbitrary-m and arbitrary-D theorem; the integral factorization and kernel argument do.
